channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Jefferson Parish (LA) Firefighters Rescue Man Trapped Inside Garbage Truck
item.description: A sanitation worker found a man trapped in his garbage truck after he was unknowingly dumped in from a dumpster. Fire crews extricated him, and he was hospitalized with minor injuries.

item.title: MD Man, 79, Dies Trying to Fuel Burn Barrel Fired with Gasoline
item.description: A 79-year-old Dundalk man died from injuries sustained in a burn barrel explosion while using gasoline to accelerate a fire, marking the fifth fire fatality in Baltimore County this year.

item.title: Crews Battle Three-Alarm Fire at NJ Manufacturing Plant
item.description: A three-alarm fire occurred at the McWane Ductile Plant in Phillipsburg on Sunday. Despite challenges, firefighters were able to still bring the fire under control within 30 minutes.

item.title: CT Ice Rink Evacuated Due to Carbon Monoxide Release
item.description: Newington Arena was evacuated due to high carbon monoxide levels, with the source unknown.

item.title: Chemical Exposure at Fire Sends 10 MO Firefighters to Hospital
item.description: Ten firefighters were sent to a Joplin hospital after exposure to a caustic liquid while battling a fire at Black Cat Trucking.

item.title: Six-Story Building Collapses in Lebanon, Killing 15
item.description: At least 15 people died in a building collapse in Tripoli, Lebanon. Additional people sustained injuries from the incident, and at least one person suffered a gunshot wound.

item.title: Firefighters Rescue WA Construction Worker with Ladder Truck After Fall
item.description: A construction worker fell two stories at The Majestic Apartments site in Wenatchee and was hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries after being rescued by firefighters.

item.title: Mayday Monday: Focus on Heart Health
item.description: February is Heart Health Month. For most people, that’s a reminder. For firefighters, it’s a warning.

item.title: Truck Crashes into IL Home, Causing Fire and Partial Collapse
item.description: A truck struck a home in Moline early Saturday, causing a fire and partial collapse. One person was hospitalized, and residents were displaced. Investigations into the crash and fire are ongoing.

item.title: Firefighters Rescue Man from MI Parking Garage Collapse
item.description: A parking garage in Dearborn collapsed on a man who was trapped inside his vehicle. Officials are investigating the cause and anticipate the garage will need demolition.
